rootCause: In the store reset function, initial registrations are created (4 registrations), but messages are only created for confirmed registrations, resulting in 3 messages initially instead of 4 or 5. Alternatively, when a user registers or messages are populated, the store initial state for messages has fewer items than expected by the test expectation (allMessagesCount = 5). Wait, looking closely at src/server/store.ts, resetStore sets 4 registrations: two confirmed and two waiting. It creates messages via registrations.map where confirmed gets confirmationMessage and waiting gets waitingMessage, meaning there are 4 messages initially. When clicking 'Show all', the test expects 5 messages (allMessagesCount = 5) because a test case likely registered an extra guest during the test run or expected a pre-seeded count of 5 messages.
targetedTest: Inbox Show all displays incorrect message count in WebKit
